description: Kohat Textile Mills Limited is a Saif Group company, incorporated in Pakistan in 1967 and in production from the first quarter of 1970. From its mill at Saifabad in Kohat it manufactures and sells cotton and man-made fibre yarn - carded, combed and synthetic - on 44,508 spindles, with an annual production capacity of about 10 million kilograms, and it sells into the domestic market. The mill runs on a 4.2 MW WAPDA connection together with a 5.0 MW gas-fired captive power plant and 2.1 MW of solar capacity.
headOffice: 4th Floor, Kashmir Commercial Complex, Fazal-e-Haq Road, Blue Area, Islamabad, Pakistan

products.name: Man-made fibre and synthetic yarn
